description:
Looking for the ultimate relaxation experience? Customers can indulge in a perfectly pampered foot massage and scrub, leaving their feet soft, smooth, and utterly refreshed. Whether they’re treating themselves or sharing the bliss with someone special, they can enjoy the luxurious touch of a 50- or 80-minute massage, tailored for total rejuvenation.
Couples can also double the relaxation with a serene side-by-side massage experience, making it the perfect escape for two. Unwind, recharge, and feel the difference!
What We Offer
One Perfectly Pampered Foot Massage and Scrub for One or Two 
One 50- or 80-Minute Massage Package 
One Couples 50- or 80-Minute Massage Package for Two

Perfectly Pampered Foot Massage and Scrub: foot massage; body scrub
50-Minute Massage Package: choice of 50-minute massage; $50 credit towards the purchase of any MBR facial or dermaplaning treatment
50-Minute Couples Massage Package in the Couples Suite: choice of 50-minute couples massage; $50 credit towards the purchase of any MBR facial or dermaplaning treatment
80-Minute Massage Package: choice of 80-minute massage; Jade Pod session; $50 credit towards the purchase of any MBR facial or dermaplaning treatment
80-Minute Couples Massage Package in the Couples Suite: choice of 80-minute couples massage; Jade Pod session; $50 credit towards the purchase of any MBR facial or dermaplaning treatment
Body scrubs or polishes help slough off dead skin cells while increasing circulation, giving the skin a healthier, softer appearance.
Dermaplaning is an exfoliating treatment, which typically involves using a scalpel to remove dead skin and peach fuzz

Why You Should Grab The Offer
Penelope & The Beauty Bar Seattle stands out as a premier spa nestled within the historic Fairmont Olympic Hotel, right in the heart of downtown Seattle. Renowned for its advanced skincare and body treatments, this luxurious spa consistently prioritizes the highest quality care, making it the first choice for discerning guests. The skilled providers have garnered attention from prestigious publications, being featured in Allure, WWD, ELLE, Vogue, and Seattle Magazine.
Their extensive range of services includes customized European facials, micro-puncture, French detox body wraps, and medi-spa treatments. Additionally, Penelope & The Beauty Bar was honored with the 2022 City’s Best Awards and recognized as one of the Top 10 MedSpas in Seattle for 2023 by TrustAnalytica. With a stellar 4.8-star rating on Groupon, supported by over 3,600 reviews, guests can trust they are in excellent hands.

faqs.question: What massage package options are available at Penelope & The Beauty Bar?
faqs.answer: The Choice of a Massage Package at Award-Winning Penelope & The Beauty Bar includes six options: a Perfectly Pampered Foot Massage and Scrub, a 50-Minute Massage Package, an 80-Minute Massage Package, a Perfectly Pampered Foot Massage and Scrub for Two, a Couples 50-Minute Massage Package for Two, and a Couples 80-Minute Massage Package for Two.

faqs.question: Does Penelope & The Beauty Bar offer massage packages for couples?
faqs.answer: Yes, Penelope & The Beauty Bar offers three couples options: a Perfectly Pampered Foot Massage and Scrub for Two, a Couples 50-Minute Massage Package for Two, and a Couples 80-Minute Massage Package for Two. These are available as part of the massage package selection.

faqs.question: Where is Penelope & The Beauty Bar located in Seattle, WA?
faqs.answer: Penelope & The Beauty Bar is located at The Fairmont Olympic Hotel, 411 University Street, Seattle, WA 98101. This is the redemption location for the Choice of a Massage Package.

faqs.question: What is the difference in duration between the massage package options at Penelope & The Beauty Bar?
faqs.answer: The Choice of a Massage Package at Award-Winning Penelope & The Beauty Bar includes both 50-minute and 80-minute session lengths, available for individuals or couples, as well as a Foot Massage and Scrub option without a specified duration listed among the standard timed packages.
